$comment: Authoritative attestation reference for the production publicai-gateway CVM (sub2api single-enclave architecture). Fetched at runtime by the /proof page (see frontend/src/utils/attestation/reference.ts). Every change to this file is public git history — that is part of the trust story. composeHash was read back from the CVM's RTMR3 via the attestor on 2026-07-28; it was also predicted before the upgrade by rebuilding the app-compose.json wrapper Phala stores for this CVM (sha256 over the null-stripped, key-sorted, compact JSON) and swapping in the new compose text — prediction and RTMR3 read-back agree, so the publish window after an upgrade is now seconds rather than minutes. Image digests are the linux/amd64 children of the cosign-signed proof-v11 indexes built from sourceCommit by publish-tee-images (run 30344520905). proof-v11 fixes a design flaw in /proof itself: when reference.json could not be fetched, the page silently compared the live enclave against the copy baked into the measured image — a copy that can never be current by construction — and reported the resulting mismatch as 'Verification FAILED, do not trust this service'. Such a mismatch is now reported as undecided and does not gate the verdict; only a mismatch against this authoritative file still fails. A CDN mirror was added as a middle fallback. The enclave's E2EE public key is derived from the app key and is unchanged across this upgrade.
